_comment: Copy to data/config.json (gitignored) and edit. Restart server.py after editing by hand; the Settings page writes this file for you.
_game_root_comment: Folder that holds stbc.exe. Empty = STBC_GAME_ROOT env var, else the current directory.
_model_comment: Ollama model for the offline brain and the 'local' side in brains sparring. qwen3:8b is smarter but slower. Ollama's address comes from the OLLAMA_URL env var (default http://localhost:11434).
_banter_comment: false = orders-only brain (shorter prompt, faster decisions). true = the in-character chat channel.
_brain_mode_comment: offline = the Ollama model flies every live decision (free). online = Claude (online_model) flies them and Ollama covers any call that fails.
_api_key_comment: Anthropic API key. Prefer the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable, which wins over this field. Empty = offline only, no strategist.
_god_ships_comment: Extra hull class ids barred from 'nogods' sparring drafts (case-insensitive).
_auto_race_exclude_comment: null = built-in list. Otherwise a list of race names the auto sparring picker never drafts unprompted.
